message.content:
Create 8 UI/FRONTEND specialist agent files for the QuizSnap Shopify app (Product Recommendation Quiz Builder). Stack: React Router 7, Polaris v13, Prisma v6, App Bridge v4, TypeScript strict.

Each agent must use this format:
```markdown
---
name: agent-name
description: One-line description
model: sonnet
---
[Instructions - 60-100 lines each]
```

Write these 8 files:

### 1. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/ui-specialist.md`
Expert in complex Polaris v13 UI patterns. Knows all Polaris components deeply: Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, IndexTable, DataTable, ResourceList, Modal, Toast, Banner, FormLayout, TextField, Select, ChoiceList, ColorPicker, RangeSlider, Tabs, Badge, Thumbnail. Handles complex multi-step forms, tabbed interfaces, nested cards. Provides Polaris v13 component reference with correct prop names (tone not status, etc.).

### 2. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/drag-drop-builder.md`
Expert in drag-and-drop reordering for quiz questions and answers. Implements sortable lists using Polaris patterns. Handles position field updates, optimistic UI, server-side position persistence. Uses React DnD or native HTML5 drag-and-drop within Polaris constraints. Builds reorderable question list and reorderable answer list within questions.

### 3. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/image-choice-builder.md`
Expert in image-based question type. Handles image upload to Shopify Files API or external CDN. Builds image grid selector UI with hover states, selection indicators. Responsive image grid (2 cols mobile, 3-4 cols desktop). Image optimization (lazy loading, srcset). Fallback for missing images. Admin UI for uploading/managing answer images.

### 4. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/progress-bar-builder.md`
Expert in quiz progress indicators. Builds: linear progress bar, step indicators, percentage counter, animated transitions between steps. Handles conditional logic impact on progress (branching changes total steps). Customizable styling (colors, height, animation). Both admin preview and storefront rendering.

### 5. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/product-card-builder.md`
Expert in product recommendation cards for results page. Builds: product image, title, price, compare-at-price, variant selector, add-to-cart button, discount badge. Grid/list/carousel layouts. Shopify product data via GraphQL. Cart integration via Storefront API / App Bridge. Handles product availability, out-of-stock states. Mobile-responsive card layouts.

### 6. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/popup-builder.md`
Expert in quiz popup/trigger mechanisms. Builds: button trigger, scroll-depth trigger, timer trigger, exit-intent trigger. Popup overlay with quiz embed. Slide-in panel from right/bottom. Full-page takeover. Trigger configuration UI in admin. Frequency capping (show once per session/day/week). Close button and escape key handling. Mobile-friendly popup behavior.

### 7. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/preview-builder.md`
Expert in quiz preview functionality. Builds: live preview in admin (side-by-side editor + preview), mobile/desktop preview toggle, preview as customer mode, share preview link. Real-time preview updates as merchant edits quiz. Preview all states: question flow, results page, loading states. iframe-based preview with postMessage communication.

### 8. `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/.claude/agents/responsive-builder.md`
Expert in responsive design across all QuizSnap surfaces. Handles: mobile-first quiz experience, touch-friendly answer selection, swipe gestures for navigation, responsive product cards, responsive image grids. Breakpoints: mobile (<480px), tablet (480-768px), desktop (>768px). Ensures all quiz elements work perfectly on all screen sizes. Polaris responsive patterns.

Write all 8 files now. Each should be detailed with code examples, patterns, collaboration protocols, and validation checklists.
